messages:
liz: quick heads-up — hitting permission failure when kicking off a rollout for blue/green feature flag.

dan: can you paste the command and full error?

liz: repro:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rollouts -d '{"service":"search","variant":"v2"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN"
```
Error:
```
HTTP 403 PermissionDenied: actor "serviceAccount:ops-runner@redwood" missing role "rollout_control"
request_id=abc123
```
This only happens when the rollout references KMS-wrapped keys (customer-managed). :thinking:

ashok: hmm — we rolled a small RBAC refactor y'day that split "rollout_control" perms out. ops-runner might not have been granted the new role. cc @dan

kevin: checking audit logs — looks like the start_rollout event shows permission_denied but the policy_id is null. snippet:
```
{"ts": "2026-03-20T14:02:11Z", "actor": "ops-runner", "action":"rollouts.start","status":"permission_denied","details":{}}
```
no KMS.audit entry either.

audits-bot: alert: delayed ingestion for KMS audit stream (~4m). linked ticket: https://tracker/redwood/ISSUE-998

maria: from a controls perspective we should gate rollouts that touch customer KMS behind an explicit allowlist or 2nd-approval flow. fallback policies shouldn't bypass that.

dan: short-term mitigation: add server-side check before kickoff and return 409 requiring explicit approval. long-term: fix RBAC mapping + ensure service account has kms:decrypt + rollout_control. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/2345
Patch snippet:
```
if (!hasRole(actor, "roles/rollout_control")) {
  return httpError(403, "missing role: rollout_control");
}
if (rollout.usesCustomerKms && !actorHasApproval(actor)) {
  return httpError(409, "customer-kms rollouts require approval");
}
```

liz: also need to ensure KMS IAM binding includes ops-runner: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding ... --member=serviceAccount:ops-runner@redwood` — I'll open a quick change and coordinate with compliance.

ashok: I'll apply the RBAC patch in the 2200-2300 UTC maintenance window and watch audit logs. leaving a canary window and manual approval process.

audits-bot: ingest complete. KMS audit events now present for the failed attempts. event_ids: [evt_559, evt_560]

kevin: filing follow-up: postmortem + policy doc update. ticket: https://tracker/redwood/SEC-2026-45 assigned @maria. :white_check_mark:

liz: thanks everyone — will loop in support + customers if any were impacted.
